subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-27, first of two on book p139, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the spectacle-diversion syndrome is the progressional platform underlying how events on the physical universe level are manipulated and perceived — as a controlling factor that moves to affect one's ability to participate in actual life or relevant change.' (C)WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what world-expansion produces when crossed with progressional-continuance in a culture where the spectacle-diversion is the progressional platform itself. METH (methodology), ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics), SPT-DY (spectacle dynamics), EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), INFO-INTG (information integration) are upper feeds. OP-SD (option spread) is a central convergence. COS-P (cosmic particulars), POL-DY (political dynamics) feed the right side. INFO-SOLD (information solidification), RE-ST (restructuralism), STF (source transfer), APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), RE-CONT (recontinuance), AF-NT (affinity nature), PHY-U-C (physical universe context), RT-ALGN (reality alignment), TR (transformation) constitute the lower structural ground. Structural argument: world-expansion crossed with progressional-continuance produces a densely-fed convergence at option-spread, with the entire spectacle-diversion machinery (information-solidification, applied-redefinitions, source-transfer) feeding the apparatus that constrains real options.
